semantic.justification: Original inclusive typed-block traversal and borrowed const cursor continuation. Block73 extends the prior bounded slices with native local/ODFF rectangular and whole-axis double references,shared RangeLine compilation,default scalar intersection,range aggregate execution over actual typed stores,and ordinary area-slot dependency ownership. Native logarithmic slot geometry,shared identity,bulk/deferred erasure,reference-update chaining,sheet shifts and semantic destruction are consumed without individual-cell listener expansion. ScValueIterator and RangeColumnSpanSet use actual document/column stores;portable array accumulation retains original four-stream Kahan order. Typed double out-references preserve encoded NaN payload storage. Earlier exclusions of these specific services are superseded here. Group/3D/external/named-reference expressions,matrix evaluation,nondefault subtotal/text-zero and number-format services remain unsupported;broader parity remains unverified. CALC250-252 record retained upstream edge behavior and limits on numerical evidence. Block75 column/group work in progress ports original CompareByTokenArray over actual RPN then lexical references and native cached hash. Start/EndListeningContext share actual ColumnBlockPositionSet cursors and segmented deferred-empty broadcaster spans;explicit purge uses real stores,old code and position deltas. Native NeedsListening and detective flags,always subscriptions and ordinary/context removal differ at their original old-code check. SharedFormulaUtil owns original nonshared template grouping,split,join,unshare and enabled lexical group-listening traversal. Column insertion now joins compatible neighbors;removal records original surviving spans and restarts actual group subscriptions,including partial-block backtracking/excess members. Document delayed grouping owns the original nullable ScRange;whole-column GroupFormulaCells retains and merges existing groups. Source CopyToDocument/attribute-copy definitions moved to documen7 on the same document instance for file-size limits. Normal immediate-edit local-reference profile only:clip/undo/no-listening/change-track/inserting modes,delayed-start batching,group compileCode and final history/native differential/raw100 acceptance remain pending. Matrix cell constructors remain unrepresented while matrix/external RPN comparison rejection is retained. No broad behavior,contract or default parity is certified. Task76 general-copy progress ports original CopyCellsFromClipHandler and CopyTextAttrsFromClipHandler with real typed source blocks,two content/metadata passes,independent native cursor values,context writeback and foreign string re-interning. ScColumn scalar/hinted SetValue/SetRawString/SetFormulaCell overloads retain native defaults,return contracts,broadcast controls and actual group/listener owners. Table2 CopyFromClip validates/clamps the destination and dispatches actual source columns;CONTENTS preserves destination patterns and geometry. ParseBlock now represents its actual container-event template and borrowed node fields;bounded ProcessFormula dispatches real formula pointers and separate non-formula spans. Original column/table/document SetDirtyFromClip,rectangular individual/area BroadcastCells and deferred BroadcastAction use existing bulk owners and actual subscriptions;cached formula results are dirtied only in completion. Matrix,foreign-pool formulas,number-format inheritance,full formatter/notes/edit/drawing services,group-compute cache invalidation and shell/UNO stream notifications remain unrepresented. Native general document/reference orchestration,paste undo/redo and EnterBlock/UI acceptance remain pending;this is not full task76 acceptance or full parity.
